//: PROPOSAL — NOT APPLIED. Entries in runtime/core/slo-targets.ts SLO_TARGETS shape; status PROPOSED. Applying requires an owner/CTO decision (it would become CONFIGURED with owner provenance). Alert thresholds and freeze rules are PROPOSALS too — nothing is wired or active.

entries.definition: scheduled-slot SLI: good mission-runner ticks / (logged ticks + missing scheduled slots), cadence 15 min (odg-mission-runner.timer); unavailable = STARTUP_REFUSED | AUDIT_CHAIN_TAMPERED | status outside the producer allowlist | missing slot (gap > 1.5× cadence ⇒ floor(gap/cadence)−1); rolling 14 days

provenance.authoredBy: Claude Code (technical provider) — NOT a CTO/owner decision

entries.definition: fraction of decisive (success|failure) runs of the required check 'build + typecheck + parity + tests' triggered by push to main; pull_request runs excluded (development signal, not an SLO); cancelled excluded; rolling 30 days (evidence window so far: 2026-11-08T22:11:44Z → 2026-11-22T04:58:16Z, 452 runs)

provenance.authoredBy: Claude Code (technical provider) — NOT a CTO/owner decision

alertAndFreezeProposals.status: PROPOSED — NOT APPLIED (no alert wired, no freeze active; owner decision)

alerts.rule: alert if ≥ 4 consecutive unavailable scheduled slots (1 h, missing ticks included) OR ≥ 4 unavailable slots in one UTC day (burn ≥ 2× at 98%: 2 × 0.02 × 96 = 3.84)
alert on every failed push-to-main run (at ~34.04 runs/day one failure already burns > 2× the daily 99% budget, so a per-day burn alert degenerates to 'any failure')

freezeRules.rule: if the rolling 14-day budget is exhausted: no change to mission-runner / Truth-Lock / scheduler code other than availability fixes, until the budget is positive again
if the rolling 30-day budget is exhausted: merges to main restricted to CI/reliability fixes until the budget is positive again

supersedes: previous proposal (ac87cd94): AUTONOMY_AVAILABILITY 0.98 on logged rows; CI_REQUIRED_CHECK_SUCCESS 0.98 on mixed push+PR runs
